findings.message: The evidence recommends release and claims every requirement is verified, but records no visual witness or inspection result. The approved plan requires visual inspection against the pinned screenshot and representative desktop/tablet widths; AC-004 is specifically visual-only. The implementation summary also says these inspections remain necessary. Record the actual source-bound visual outcomes (including desktop and tablet usability) before claiming these clauses verified; otherwise return them as unverified.
